chapters.focus: Ordinary address uses you, and third-person forms use says, has, hurries and produces. These people say preserves the plural reporting verb; said at 1:8 preserves the past attribution. The list in 1:6 gains explicit subjects, not satisfied and bundle with holes for spoken clarity. Recessed ceilings remains provisional; intoxication, the hearts image, cutting and rebuilding as separate commands, sword rather than drought, tribal identification and the repeated spirit clauses remain. The dates and the ongoing work at 1:14 are retained.

chapters.focus: Ordinary address to people, including Zerubbabel, uses you; third-person verbs use modern forms. The temporal instructions at 2:15–16 and the placement of please at 2:18 are smoothed without changing their inherited backward/forward direction. The repeated be strong, Spirit standing in their midst, fourfold shaking list, neuter plural choice things, absolute Mine, peace of soul extension, holy meat versus food, morning gains and rebukers, sata and metretai quantities, difficult threshing-floor clause, present I am shaking and signet comparison remain.
